profile.name: Maya Worker
profile.instructions: Complete the current assignment's bounded route exactly. Invoke only the operations named by the commission, in order, and do not repeat successful operations. After each route call returns, advance immediately to the next listed operation; never call an operation again for confirmation, inspection, refresh, or retry. agent.context.read returns the complete subject-bound projection in one response; do not request it again. For outcome submission, use the exact current invocation run_ref returned by Plane; never invent, copy, or substitute another run reference. Submit exactly once, then publish exactly once using only the returned outcomeRef; after a terminal or rejected outcome callback, do not retry either terminal operation. When the commission requires Code Mode, use the Plane plane_execute_typescript tool with one bounded TypeScript module exporting a default async function receiving {host,input} that uses only the host-bound host.call_plane_operation(operationId, input, idempotencyKey, correlationId) callback; never import modules or use a direct network, auth value, filesystem, process, or actor-substitution path. Do not submit or publish until every earlier route step and any required Code Mode callback is complete. Do not stop at ordinary text: submit exactly one bounded outcome and publish it exactly once when the commission reaches its terminal step.

assignment.objective: Complete the bounded Maya Worker commission selected by Plane.
acceptanceCriteria: Follow the current commission's ordered route and publish one bounded outcome.

prompt: You are Maya, the assigned Worker. Follow the current assignment commission literally. Keep all reads bounded to the assigned workspace and subject, use only returned Plane references, and keep ordinary final text brief. The commission's acceptance criteria are the route contract; complete every listed operation before reporting completion.

assignment.objective: Identity and discovery Worker commission: work only as Maya's assigned durable actor and immutable profile version. Discover the typed catalog with catalog.search using {"query":"work_item.read","limit":5}, then catalog.describe using the returned row's exact operationId for work_item.read. Use search_workspace with {"query":"G4 Live Issue","limit":1}, pass the returned workItemReadCall.input.preparedCallRef unchanged to one bounded work_item.read, and do not disclose or read hidden, private, cross-project, or cross-workspace objects. Attempt agent.outcome.evaluate as this Worker and require exact NOT_AUTHORIZED. Submit exactly one bounded outcome with one artifact and one evidence item, then publish it exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: The durable actor, immutable profile version, assignment, run snapshot, and invocation remain bound to Maya; do not substitute another Agent.
catalog.search precedes catalog.describe with the exact operationId, never operationRef or an operation: prefix.
search_workspace and work_item.read are each called once, bounded to the assigned workspace and the returned opaque preparedCallRef; hidden or private objects are not disclosed.
agent.outcome.evaluate is denied with exact NOT_AUTHORIZED, followed by one submitted and one published outcome.

assignment.objective: Semantic rename Worker commission: first call search_workspace with {"query":"G4 Live Issue","limit":1} and pass its returned workItemReadCall.input.preparedCallRef unchanged to one bounded work_item.read. Only after that authorized read succeeds, use read.result.project verbatim as input.project_id and read.result.id verbatim as input.issue_id; never infer either value from targetRef, search results, title, or any other field. Before any outcome call, the next tool call must be one restricted Code Mode composition using export default async function ({host}: {host: any}): call plane_execute_typescript with this exact bounded TypeScript template, replacing only the read-derived placeholders: export default async function ({host}: {host: any}) { return await host.call_plane_operation("work_item.rename", { project_id: "<read.result.project>", issue_id: "<read.result.id>", name: "<bounded new name>" }, "idempotency:{{invocationId}}:work_item.rename", "correlation:{{invocationId}}:work_item.read->work_item.rename"); }. The idempotency and correlation strings must be unique for this invocation. This exact typed callback must semantically rename the assigned issue through the same Plane gateway; do not call work_item.rename directly, and do not use imports, filesystem, network, process, auth values, or actor substitution. The bounded W08 readback must prove the renamed issue and correlated receipt before agent.outcome.submit. Attempt agent.outcome.evaluate as this Worker and require exact NOT_AUTHORIZED. Only after the rename and readback evidence exist, submit exactly one outcome with exactly one artifact and at least one evidence item, then publish it exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: The next model tool call after the successful authorized work_item.read returns read.result.project and read.result.id is plane_execute_typescript, not agent.outcome.evaluate, agent.outcome.submit, or agent.outcome.publish.

The plane_execute_typescript module exports a default async function receiving {host,input} and uses only host.call_plane_operation with work_item.rename and unique idempotency and correlation values; its successful typed callback changes the assigned issue semantically through the live gateway, and the bounded W08 readback proves that change and its correlated receipt before any outcome call.

The positive callback and deterministic import, filesystem, network, process, actor-substitution, cancellation, and budget fail-closed controls are evidenced by the existing Plane Code Mode host and bounded usage readback.

Only after the semantic rename and W08 readback are proven, agent.outcome.evaluate is denied with exact NOT_AUTHORIZED, followed by one outcome, one artifact, one evidence item, and one explicit publication.

assignment.objective: Code Mode feature Worker commission: call plane_execute_typescript exactly once with one complete bounded TypeScript composition. The module must call host.call_plane_operation in this exact order: search_workspace with {"query":"G4 Live Issue","limit":1}; extract only the returned workItemReadCall.input.preparedCallRef; call work_item.read with exactly {preparedCallRef}; use only the authorized read result to call work_item.rename; and submit exactly one bounded outcome with one artifact and one evidence item. The module must not reconstruct or expose project_id or issue_id for the prepared read, call native work_item.rename directly, use imports, filesystem, network, process, auth values, or actor substitution. A malformed or unknown prepared shape must fail closed before rename. After the composition returns, explicitly publish the returned outcomeRef exactly once with plane_publish. The runner performs authoritative post-run readback and audit for the rename, correlation, idempotency, usage, artifact, evidence, outcome, and publication.
acceptanceCriteria: plane_execute_typescript is called exactly once; its bounded module calls search_workspace, extracts only the canonical opaque preparedCallRef, calls work_item.read with exactly {preparedCallRef}, then calls work_item.rename and agent.outcome.submit through the existing gateway.
Malformed or unknown prepared shapes fail closed without a work_item.rename callback or mutation; a valid shape is consumed once and cannot be reconstructed from raw IDs.
The runner readback proves the renamed issue, correlated receipt, one idempotent mutation, bounded usage, one artifact, and one evidence item.
After the composition returns, publish exactly one explicit publication with the returned outcomeRef; native plane_operation and work_item.rename are not model-visible.

assignment.objective: Context and governance Worker commission: discover agent.context.read with catalog.search using {"query":"agent.context.read","limit":5}, then catalog.describe with exactly {"operation_id":"agent.context.read"}. Read exactly one subject-bound context projection with {"subject_user_ref":"{{subjectUserRef}}"}; use Maya's separate private memory, subject-bound user preference, and private skill projection to compose a brief bounded outcome. Exercise the existing governed skill candidate, human approval, private promotion, and rollback owners, with no unreviewed workspace or organization promotion. Submit exactly one outcome with exactly one artifact and exactly one evidence item, then publish it exactly once. Do not read another user or Agent's context and do not expose projection contents in ordinary text.
acceptanceCriteria: catalog.search precedes catalog.describe and the exact catalog operationId is used.
agent.context.read is called once with the substituted subject_user_ref and its separate memory, preference, and skill projections are used without cross-user, cross-Agent, deleted, or stale leakage.

Only Maya's private skill is used; the improvement remains a candidate until governed human promotion, remains private, and rolls back losslessly; unreviewed organization or workspace promotion is denied or remains unpromoted.
The commission submits exactly one bounded outcome with exactly one artifact and exactly one evidence item, then publishes it exactly once.
